title: task_list — the ralph plan's Task list and its disposition (docs/ralph C2)
description: The ralph plan agent's output. It encodes plan_gate's shape checks at the structural level: the disposition enum, non-empty strings on every contradiction field, and the seven Task fields with a non-empty acceptance list and a 12,000-byte context. The cross-field rules (tasks only for ready, contradictions only for contradiction, unique ids, the remainder split at 8) are gate checks and stay in plan_gate, because a schema cannot see the other fields. _io is stamped by the server.

disposition.description: ready: the tasks array is the run's Task list. redundant and invalid: there is no work, and close_noop ends the run. contradiction: the issue asks for something its own non-goals forbid, and return_to_triage sends it back with a question. needs_human: a human decision blocks the work, and mark_stuck ends the run with the summary.

summary.description: Two or three sentences for the operator: what the issue needs, and why this disposition.

contradictions.description: The criteria the issue's own boundaries forbid; [] unless the disposition is contradiction.

tasks.description: The ordered Task list; non-empty only for ready. The first 8 are worked in this run and the rest become the Remainder issue.

id.description: Unique within the Task list, e.g. t1. Every later Tasks.json entry keeps it.

body.description: What to change and why, in the reporter's terms.

acceptance.description: One checkable statement each, traceable to the issue. This is the definition of done for the Iteration that works the Task.

files.description: Repository-relative paths the Task expects to touch; a hint, not a ceiling.

covers.description: The issue requirements this Task serves.

context.description: Markdown for the Iteration: '## Files and symbols', '## Plan' (one step per edit, each with path:N-M) and '## Done when'. excerpts copies every path:N-M it finds.
